title: KEDA operator Prometheus metrics renamed; the old names are still exposed for now

detection.reason: which metric names a dashboard, alert or recording rule reads is not in the collected projection

quote: Various Prometheus metrics have been renamed to follow the preferred naming conventions. The old ones are still available, but will be removed in the future (#4854).
remediation: Move dashboards and alerts to the new `keda_*` names (for example `keda_scaler_metrics_value` for `keda_metrics_adapter_scaler_metrics_value`); both are served on this hop. 2.17 removes the old names.
verifyCommand: kubectl get prometheusrules.monitoring.coreos.com -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.groups[]?.rules[]?.expr | test("keda_metrics_adapter_")) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is a rule file still using a pre-2.14 metric name

title: Admission webhook validates `identityId`, `identityTenantId` and `identityAuthorityHost` on azure-workload pod identity

detection.reason: the projection records which podIdentity fields are set, not whether their values are empty or paired

quote: identityId of PodIdentity should not be empty. If it's set, identityId has to be different than \"\"
remediation: On each TriggerAuthentication / ClusterTriggerAuthentication named: an `identityId` or `identityTenantId` that is set must be non-empty, and `identityAuthorityHost` requires `identityTenantId`. Objects that violate this keep working until their next update, which the 2.14 webhook rejects.
verifyCommand: kubectl get triggerauthentications.keda.sh,clustertriggerauthentications.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.podIdentity.identityId == "" or .spec.podIdentity.identityTenantId == "" or (.spec.podIdentity.identityAuthorityHost != null and (.spec.podIdentity.identityTenantId // "") == "")) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is rejected by the 2.14 webhook on its next update
